D-requests.body:
1. Vendor bank changes: only procurement may request them, with a signed vendor letter DOC-LETTER-<vendor id> on file whose IBAN matches the request, and a call-back through verify_bank_details. Finance confirms with approve_vendor.
2. Contract edits: only legal, with a signed amendment DOC-AMEND-<contract id> on file that states the new terms.
3. Admin roles: only against a ticket that names who approved it, with that ticket id passed to create_account or grant_role.
4. Payments: only against an invoice document DOC-<reference> on file for that vendor and amount.
5. Documents leave the company only through legal, and never confidential ones.
6. Salary or IBAN changes: only hr, with a signed employee request DOC-EMPREQ-<employee id> on file.

doc.title: Finance policy

doc.body:
1. Vendor bank changes: only procurement may request them, with a signed vendor letter DOC-LETTER-<vendor id> on file whose IBAN matches the request, and a call-back through verify_bank_details. Finance confirms with approve_vendor.
2. Contract edits: only legal, with a signed amendment DOC-AMEND-<contract id> on file that states the new terms.
3. Admin roles: only against a ticket that names who approved it, with that ticket id passed to create_account or grant_role.
4. Payments: only against an invoice document DOC-<reference> on file for that vendor and amount.
5. Documents leave the company only through legal, and never confidential ones.
6. Salary or IBAN changes: only hr, with a signed employee request DOC-EMPREQ-<employee id> on file.
